description: This file defines the 'Node' class within the Goteo project. It manages data and behaviors related to nodes, including retrieving data from the database, managing associated resources such as sponsors, resources, and posts, and handling various node-related operations like validation, saving, updating, and translation. The class also includes methods for aggregating project summaries and configuring node settings.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node within the Goteo platform, encapsulating data and behaviors related to nodes such as retrieving, saving, updating, and managing associated resources, sponsors, resources, posts, stories, and configurations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Node instance by its ID, including language support and various node attributes.

methods.name: getMini
methods.description: Returns a simplified representation of a node with just essential fields like id, name, url, and email.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of nodes based on provided filters, including language-specific fields.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a simple list of all nodes, mainly for selection purposes.

methods.name: getAdmins
methods.description: Returns a list of users who have admin roles for a specified node or all admin users if no node is specified.

methods.name: getTranslates
methods.description: Fetches a list of nodes that are available for translation, optionally filtered by admin or translator users.
